newsitem.title: ITALY: RUGBY UNION-TREVISO SIGN SOUTH AFRICAN SHERRELL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TREVISO SIGN SOUTH AFRICAN SHERRELL.

text.p: Italy's Benetton Treviso rugby union club said on Thursday they had signed Northern Transvaal flyhalf Lance Sherrell.
The club said the 20-year-old, who toured New Zealand with the Springboks in 1994, would arrive in the next few weeks.
Sherrell was drafted in as a replacement for Western Samoan flyhalf Darren Kellett, who left the club last month due to lingering injury problems, as the club's foreign player.
Under Italian rugby regulations first division clubs are allowed to field only one foreigner with a transfer deadline in December, after which new signings cannot be made.
